name: Bypass Blocks
axeNote: axe classifies the landmark rules as best-practice rather than WCAG-tagged, so a scan filtered to WCAG tags alone reports nothing here. Its own bypass rule returns incomplete rather than a violation, because it cannot determine from the DOM whether a skip mechanism works.
manualCheck: Press Tab once on a cold load and use the skip link. axe cannot determine from the DOM whether a skip mechanism works, so its bypass rule returns incomplete and never a violation. Confirm the link is visible when focused, that it moves focus rather than only scrolling, and that the target is not then hidden under a sticky header. See 2.4.11.
